meta.scope: Correct S072 unsupported healthy-subject and participant-denominator claims

records.title: AI-based bi-modal fusion system for automated clinical pain monitoring

decisions.notes: Only the official PubMed abstract was accessible for the reported results; it states an average accuracy improvement of 3.88% across 11 X-ITE sub-datasets and a 7.12% gain on R-ETD, without specifying percentage-point changes. Participant count, split unit, exact class definitions, absolute performance, confidence intervals, calibration and external validation remain unestablished. X-ITE is an experimental-pain database; the word 'clinical' in the title does not establish clinical-outcome validation. Official publisher full text was not retrieved (ScienceDirect returned HTTP 403; full-text API required authentication). A 2026-09-28 recheck of NLM E-utilities abstract confirms 11 sub-datasets, not a participant denominator; healthy participant status is not established by this source.
